name: tineghir-website
description: Static tourism website for Tineghir, Morocco

scripts.check: npm run check:pages && npm run content:check && npm run i18n:check && npm test
scripts.build: npm run pages && npm run build:js && tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o ./public/style.css
scripts.cap:sync: npm run tiles:fetch && npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:sync: npm run tiles:fetch && npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:build-debug: npm run tiles:fetch && npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:build-debug-win: npm run tiles:fetch && npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle-release: npm run tiles:fetch && npm run build && node scripts/release-version.mjs --apply && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
